hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command' 2>/dev/null); if echo "$cmd" | grep -q 'git.*commit'; then msg=$(echo "$cmd" | grep -oP '(?<=-m\s+['\'']).*?(?=['\''])|(?<=-m\s+)\S+' | head -1 | sed "s/^['\"']//;s/['\"]$//"); if [ -n "$msg" ] && ! echo "$msg" | grep -qE '^\[(Patch|Minor|Major|BREAKING)\]'; then echo '{"continue": false, "stopReason": "Commit message must start with [Patch], [Minor], [Major], or [BREAKING]. Example: [Patch] Fix featured image sync"}' | jq -c .; exit 1; fi; fi
